title: pm-spec tickets.json
description: A change's work items in a neutral format: one epic for the change and one task per capability. Written by pm-spec at handoff, in specs/changes/<name>/tickets.json. It names no ticket system; mapping it into one is the reader's job.

id.description: Local and stable across runs: the change name for the epic, <change>/<capability> for a task.

parent.description: The id of the parent item, or null for the epic.

acceptance.description: A checklist: the requirement and scenario titles of the task's requirements file.

ref.description: The ref the item came in with (--ticket-ref for the epic, --ticket-child for a task), as an opaque string.
